reviewObservations: Actual session actor is separate from original15proposed identities; proposed contribution and readiness never activates employee or grants business authority.
Preparation/minutes require separate exact task/recommendation/decision packets, current source versions and immutable receipts. Minutes corrections leave unrelated preparation valid.

Corporate metadata is an explicit founder attestation bound to current source version/hash, not an automatic classifier or data-loss-prevention system. Operator-entered prose remains an attributed claim. Ordinary founder knowledge/task detail remains founder-only existing local workspace access; Council pickers use separate safe projections.

Audit/receipt exceptions roll back full command including generated records and task/project links. Test stores use isolated owned temporary directories; browser uses fresh local sessions without resetting shared SQLite.
No live AI voice, microphone/camera, invitations, calendar messages, external sharing, financial action, permission grant, employee activation or paid service is part of this slice.
limits: Local SQLite and loopback browser acceptance only; production identity, backup/recovery/retention and full regulated-release backlog remain separate prerequisites.

18 backend/HTTP cases include rollback, disk restart, idempotency, scope, actor/CSRF, correction, private/derived sources and stale decisions. Actual browser12groups cover normal end-to-end, all six Arabic375 editors, pending participant omission guard, unknown-response recovery and cancellation. Not every theoretical failure state of every editor was individually injected.

Initial browser-first setup failed with old cached server class and503 storage_unavailable; root restarted verified local launcher preserving DB. Initial backend-first assertion incorrectly counted all search results instead of the revoked source ID; corrected backend-second. Both raw logs are retained, not acceptance evidence.
